relevance_note: Single-patient case report of adult-onset Alexander disease with a GFAP variant: "Results from this test identified a predicted deleterious variant, p.Glu207Val, c.620A>T, in exon 4 of GFAP".
method_note: Hand-built from a full reading of this short case report; a Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the JSON and checked spans and fields. Markdown escapes: the paper text prints '>' and 'NM\_002055.4'; spans copy these exactly, values give 'c.620A>T' and 'NM_002055.4'. Scope: the proband ('patient'); his father and 1 older brother are included as relatives described as affected ('reported problems with balance'), no variant rows because they were not tested ('other family members have refused genetic testing'). The 5 of 11 siblings with syncope are counts without names and get no rows. 'speech and breathing dysfunction were not reported in any of the affected or unaffected family members' was not used to exclude features for the father or brother ('not reported' wording is ambiguous between absent and unrecorded). Contradictions: (1) text says 'no cerebellar atrophy was observed' and the MRI 'unremarkable except for medullary and upper cervical spinal cord atrophy', but the Figure 1A legend reports 'atrophy of the midbrain medulla, vermis and cervical spinal cord'; both rows emitted. (2) Discussion says 'no other family members report similar symptoms of Alexander disease' while father and older brother 'reported problems with balance'. The normal-MRI statement is recorded as the paper words it (MRI abnormality other than medullary/cervical atrophy, excluded) and excludes no specific checklist item (D-27); cerebral white matter abnormality left not reported. Macrocephaly is hedged ('suggestive of macrocephaly'); recorded observed with the hedge in severity_or_detail. Variant type 'missense' rests on 'nonconservative amino acid substitution' stated for this variant. Zygosity and inheritance not stated for this person; the general sentence 'heterozygous missense variants in GFAP lead to a toxic gain' was not used (D-29). Vasovagal syncope (onset around age 6) was not mapped to the autonomic-dysfunction checklist item, whose listed examples do not include syncope. Age at disease onset not stated as an age (only an '8-month history' at age 52), so left not reported.
